_note: Authoritative source for all financial constants. Skills read from here, not from docs.

pricing.price_floor_note: Brand rule - no products below 1000 INR
pricing.zero_referral_fee_note: Amazon India zero referral fee for items at or below 1000 INR (effective 2026-03-16)

logistics.weight_ceiling_note: FBA optimization - products above 2 kg incur higher fulfillment fees

cbfa.description: Contribution Before Fixed Advertising. Used in Gate 1.

break_even_acos.description: Break-even Advertising Cost of Sale percentage. Used in Gate 1.

break_even_cac.description: Break-even Customer Acquisition Cost equals CBFA in rupees.
